name: Andor
description: In an era filled with danger, deception and intrigue, Cassian Andor will discover the difference he can make in the struggle against the tyrannical Galactic Empire. He embarks on a path that is destined to turn him into a rebel hero.

videos.title: Ferrix Part 1: Imperial Occupation
videos.overview: Tony Gilroy, Kathleen Kennedy and Diego Luna discuss the series origins.

videos.title: Aldhani: Rebel Heist
videos.overview: Join the shoot in Scotland with character spotlights, rebel training, stunts, a VFX breakdown and more.

videos.title: Coruscant: Whispers of Rebellion
videos.overview: Explore the stories of ISB agent Dedra, Senator Mon Mothma and spymaster Luthen Rael.

videos.title: Narkina 5: One Way Out
videos.overview: Uncover the Empire's penal system and the prison's stark look, get to know Kino Loy, and view VFX breakdowns.

videos.title: Ferrix Part 2: Fight the Empire
videos.overview: Tony Gilroy, Diego Luna, cast and crew reveal the making of the season ﬁnale.

videos.title: Kassa
videos.overview: Cassian Andor's reckless search for answers about his past makes him a wanted man.

videos.title: That Would Be Me
videos.overview: Cassian attempts to lay low on Ferrix as agents of the law close in.

videos.title: Reckoning
videos.overview: Cassian's desperation to avoid arrest leads him to a mysterious man with unknown connections.

videos.title: Aldhani
videos.overview: Out of options, Cassian is recruited for a dangerous mission to infiltrate an Imperial garrison.

videos.title: The Axe Forgets
videos.overview: Cassian must carefully navigate the distrust inherent in being the new member of a secret operation.

videos.title: The Eye
videos.overview: With cover from a spectacular local festival, the Aldhani mission reaches a point of no return.

videos.title: Announcement
videos.overview: The repercussions of the Aldhani heist reach all the way to Coruscant, while Cassian returns home.

videos.title: Narkina 5
videos.overview: The Empire catches up to Cassian, but are as yet unaware of his identity and past.

videos.title: Nobody's Listening!
videos.overview: Under intense scrutiny while imprisoned, Cassian makes allies plan an impossible escape.

videos.title: One Way Out
videos.overview: A rare opportunity opens and the time for Cassian and his fellow inmates to act is now.

videos.title: Daughter of Ferrix
videos.overview: A fugitive once more, Cassian must make his next move before it is too late.

videos.title: Rix Road
videos.overview: Cassian returns home to Ferrix, a tinderbox that is experiencing a spark of rebellion.

videos.title: One Year Later
videos.overview: An undercover mission. A sanctuary threatened. A Chandrilan wedding. A chilling Imperial plan.

videos.title: Sagrona Teema
videos.overview: Cassian caught in a rebel turf war. Mon’s wedding woes mount. The Ferrix survivors face inspection.

videos.title: Harvest
videos.overview: Time is running out for everyone.

videos.title: Ever Been to Ghorman?
videos.overview: Cassian and Bix adjust to a Luthen safehouse. All eyes are on Ghorman. Wilmon visits Saw Gerrera.

videos.title: I Have Friends Everywhere
videos.overview: Cassian on Ghorman. Syril on Coruscant. Bix failing. Wilmon trapped. Kleya has a serious problem.

videos.title: What a Festive Evening
videos.overview: Vel and Cinta to Ghorman. Cassian home to Bix. An argument. A heist. A party. Everything at risk.

videos.title: Messenger
videos.overview: Yavin is growing. Wilmon comes for help. Dedra’s on Ghorman. Cassian heeds the call.

videos.title: Who Are You?
videos.overview: Imperial manipulation. Ghorman frustration. Cassian and Syril center stage as Palmo erupts.

videos.title: Welcome to the Rebellion
videos.overview: In the Ghorman aftermath, Mon Mothma takes a stand. Cassian must carry out a difficult extraction.

videos.title: Make It Stop
videos.overview: Lonni Jung taps out. Dedra closes in. Luthen scrambles. Kleya delivers.

videos.title: Who Else Knows?
videos.overview: Cassian returns to Coruscant for one last extraction.

videos.title: Jedha, Kyber, Erso
videos.overview: Cassian returns to Yavin with intel that will change everything.

awards: Won 5 Primetime Emmys. 35 wins & 132 nominations total
